**Setup.** We are given the functional equation

$$f\bigl(x + f(x+1)\bigr) = x + 3 \qquad (\star)$$

and the initial condition $f(2) = 0$.

**Key observation (chaining rule).** Suppose we already know the value $f(k)$ at some point $k$. Substitute $x = k-1$ into $(\star)$:

$$f\bigl((k-1) + f(k)\bigr) = (k-1) + 3 = k+2.$$

So from each known pair $(k,\, f(k))$ we obtain a new known pair

$$\bigl(k',\, f(k')\bigr) = \bigl(k - 1 + f(k),\; k + 2\bigr). \qquad (\dagger)$$

Starting from the seed $(k_0, f(k_0)) = (2, 0)$, we iterate $(\dagger)$:

| Step | $k$ | $f(k)$ | new $k' = k-1+f(k)$ | new $f(k') = k+2$ |
|------|-----|--------|----------------------|-------------------|
| 0 | 2 | 0 | 1 | 4 |
| 1 | 1 | 4 | 4 | 3 |
| 2 | 4 | 3 | 6 | 6 |
| 3 | 6 | 6 | 11 | 8 |
| 4 | 11 | 8 | 18 | 13 |
| 5 | 18 | 13 | 30 | 20 |
| 6 | 30 | 20 | 49 | 32 |
| 7 | 49 | 32 | 80 | 51 |
| 8 | 80 | 51 | 130 | 82 |
| 9 | 130 | 82 | 211 | 132 |
| 10 | 211 | 132 | 342 | 213 |
| 11 | 342 | 213 | 554 | 344 |
| 12 | 554 | 344 | 897 | 556 |
| 13 | 897 | 556 | **1452** | **899** |

**Verification of the last step.** At step 12 we have $f(897) = 556$. Setting $x = 896$ in $(\star)$:

$$f\bigl(896 + f(897)\bigr) = 896 + 3 = 899.$$

Since $896 + f(897) = 896 + 556 = 1452$, we conclude

$$\boxed{f(1452) = 899}.$$
